title: RL — Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) Explained
summary: This paper explains Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), a reinforcement learning algorithm that addresses convergence problems in policy gradient methods by using a simpler first-order optimization approach with KL-divergence constraints instead of computationally expensive second-order methods. PPO uses the Minorize-Maximization framework and trust region concepts to limit policy changes in each iteration, allowing for stable and efficient training without the scalability issues of natural policy gradients.
